title: Quiz: Container Queries
description: Check your understanding of Container Queries.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in CSS?
questions.explanation: In CSS, /* */ marks a comment. Block comments use /* ... */.

questions.question: What problem do container queries solve?
questions.correctAnswer: Styling components based on their container, not the viewport

questions.question: True or False: Components can now adapt to wherever they are placed.
What is the main purpose of the Container Queries technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you container queries effectively.

questions.question: In CSS, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
